key_insight: Cubic Discrete Diffusion introduces a diffusion framework that generates directly over high-dimensional discrete representation tokens (e.g., 768–1024 dims), preserving rich semantic information while keeping a unified token-based generation paradigm.
problem_solved: Current discrete visual generation methods limit latent tokens to low dimensions (8–32), losing semantic richness; generating discrete high-dimensional pretrained representations is combinatorially hard and inefficient. This paper addresses how to perform scalable, accurate discrete generation on those high-dimensional representation tokens.
method: Define a Cubic Discrete Diffusion process tailored to high-dimensional token structures, enabling stepwise categorical transitions on representation tokens rather than low-dim latents.
Design efficient discrete noise/transition schedules and a training objective that make diffusion tractable in the high-dimensional categorical space.
Integrate with pretrained high-dimensional visual representations so the model can generate semantically rich tokens compatible with token-based multimodal architectures.
impact: Enables token-level generation that retains semantic richness of large pretrained representations, which simplifies alignment with language-style models and improves downstream multimodal generation and understanding.

paper_title: Cubic Discrete Diffusion: Discrete Visual Generation on High-Dimensional Representation Tokens
paper_authors: Yuqing Wang, Chuofan Ma, Zhijie Lin, Yao Teng, Lijun Yu
